basic_info.description: List price is Probate Court Minimum Overbid amount. This penthouse unit, located in a boutique 4-unit Edwardian building, offers stunning views! From the living room, bedroom, and functional study, enjoy panoramic views that stretch from Mt. Sutro to the Marin Headlands, including the Ocean, Bay, and Golden Gate Bridge. With an elegant formal entry that features a large skylight, this home has an abundance of natural light. The updated kitchen has granite counters and stainless appliances including a 6-burner stove. Completing this residence is a full bath with updated fixtures and a jetted tub as well as a dedicated laundry room. This unit includes FOUR CAR PARKING including a private garage. Located on a massive lot that fronts two streets and is at the doorstep of Cole Valley which has a variety of shops and local eateries. This is one of two homes that share the upper level which features an elegant formal landing, stained glass skylight and a box beam ceiling. Call today for an opportunity to see this exceptional value.
